overridableConfigKeys.label: Actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Header actions (settings, history, …). At most one explicit primary stays inline; the rest live under a single '⋯' menu — the title owns its row.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Autosave Hint
overridableConfigKeys.description: Muted caption beside Done telling the author work persists on its own

overridableConfigKeys.label: Content Change Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Forwarded to the embedded RichTextEditor's autosave stream: { value }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Cover Image
overridableConfigKeys.description: Cover/hero image URL painted as a full-bleed banner above the header row (Notion/article-hero shape); hidden when empty

overridableConfigKeys.label: Done Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emitted by the Done button that ends the editing session: { id }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edit Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emitted by the header Edit affordance and a click on the read body: { id }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Editing
overridableConfigKeys.description: false = read surface with click-to-edit body; true = live editor

overridableConfigKeys.label: Icon
overridableConfigKeys.description: Document icon rendered beside the title (a file glyph, a domain icon); hidden when empty

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Inline Actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: 0 collapses even the primary action into the menu

overridableConfigKeys.label: Subtitle
overridableConfigKeys.description: Muted byline under the title; hidden when empty

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Document title (falls back to 'Untitled' for a blank draft)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title Commit Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emitted when the title commits: { title, id }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value
overridableConfigKeys.description: The document body as rich-text HTML
